payload.friendly_name: Docsite scaffold, pinned doc-kitty and the docs-site PR build job
payload.purpose_context: Epic #6100 moves docs.spec-kitty.ai from DocFX to doc-kitty (ADR 2026-10-31-1). The frontmatter now builds (#6929). This mission adds the site/ Astro project that pins doc-kitty by commit, make targets to build and bump it, docs/_meta/sections.yaml, and a docs-site job in ci-router.yml that builds the full published corpus on every docs/site pull request and uploads site/dist. DocFX keeps deploying; the job is not yet required (#6937).
payload.purpose_tldr: Start the doc-kitty parallel run: a site/ project that builds the published docs on every docs/site pull request, while DocFX keeps deploying.

payload.wp_title: Site project and single exclusion authority
Local build and doc-kitty bump targets
